We have template info. It seems to be a disconnection of sulfonamide aryl chloride? The forward reaction: Cl-SO2-aryl + aryl-CH2-O-? Actually template shows product: [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]... with sulfonamide attached. So retrosynthetic step: break sulfonamide to give aryl chloride and aryl-CH2-O-? Wait product side: [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]... is maybe a phenoxy? Actually [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7] is a carbon attached to O attached to aromatic carbon. That seems like a benzylic ether? The template splits into two fragments: Cl-[S...]-aryl (sulfonyl chloride?) and the aryl-CH2-O- fragment.

Our target has O=S(N... )(... )=O attached to aromatic ring (sulfonamide). So applying template 20810 retrosynthetically would give sulfonyl chloride (aryl-SO2Cl) and the aryl-CH2-O- fragment (maybe a phenoxy). Let's apply template to target to get precursors.
